scope: Phase D storage foundation: content v3 / authority v2 migration + evidence-excerpt storage (no queue/provider/UI)
behavior: content v2→v3 and authority v1→v2 migration in one synchronous attached transaction with verify-before-commit and rollback; v1 content goes v1→v2→v3
historical v1/v2 schemas/signatures preserved; unknown/modified/mixed schemas refused before writes
new roots create content v3/authority v2; existing stores preserve records/work/identity/anchor/revision
excerpt register/read/forget: body in content DB, authority entry/root sources, memory dependency generation/digest, replay/refusal, byte purge on forget, secret/bounded text
snapshot v3 exports live version metadata/source refs/dependencies but no version bodies; v2/v3 restore semantics tested, version bodies fail-closed/skipped
extraction commit offers a bounded input excerpt to the queue observer; index registers an excerpt for each extracted memory best-effort
explicit memory deletion and correction purge dependent excerpt bodies via purgeExcerptsForMemory; archive retains the body but read is unavailable until restore
read-only memory.excerpts operation lists metadata/source refs for one memory without returning the body (user/HTTP and bound model session)
